notes.title: Bewitched Part I Update
notes.notes:
Greetings to all fans of our visual novel!

We are excited to announce an update to our game that brings numerous improvements, making your gaming experience even more enjoyable and immersive.

What's new in the update?

Localization in 9 new languages

Now you can play in Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Italian, and Ukrainian. This opens up our magical world to even more players.

Extended dialogues and backstories

We have added new dialogues and character information to make the story immersion even deeper.

Improved graphics quality

The graphics have become even more captivating and atmospheric, enhancing the sense of magic and wonder.

New animations

We have added new animations that make the backgrounds more lively and add dynamics to the gameplay.

Mini-games

The game now features new mini-games that diversify the gameplay and bring even more fun.

Bug fixes

We have eliminated many bugs to make your gaming experience even more comfortable.

Thank you so much for your support and feedback! They help us make the game better. Join the discussion in our community, share your impressions, and ask questions — your opinion is very important to us.

If you have any additional questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave comments or contact us directly.

We wish you an enjoyable game and see you in the magical world!
